create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing data augmentation transform with configurable probability and area range
apply_random_erasing_to_batch: apply random erasing to a batch of normalized image tensors using the call method
configure_erasing_pixel_mode: configure RandomErasing to use per-pixel random normal color mode instead of constant zero
use_erase_cube_for_batch: use the cube mode to erase the same region across all images in a batch
generate_erasing_pixels: generate random or zero fill pixels for erasing patches using the _get_pixels helper function
